description: Section/screen-level failure, with recovery and an optional diagnostic code.

icon.description: A Phosphor class name for the danger glyph Arena draws.

headingLevel.description: Which rung of the document outline the title takes. Only the element changes: the title's class is the same at every value, so the render is identical and no appearance follows from it. It defaults to `h3`, the card rung of the title ladder, for the reason an empty state does: a failure fills the body of a region something above it already names. `none` takes the headline out of the outline, which is what a failure inside a small surface wants, and it is available here because `title` carries a default rather than being required.

message.description: A sentence of detail under the title.

retryLabel.description: The label of the retry button Arena draws. Absent renders no retry.

secondaryAction.description: An extra control beside the retry (e.g. a link to logs).
